findings.summary: A narrowed marker is never restored if the narrowed run stops before its boundary, and a later full-pipeline ask does not undo it
findings.suggestion: Run hm autopilot narrow for every ask incl. the full pipeline; make narrow() restore when until equals the original last stage instead of returning 'already ends at' (autopilot.py:775).

reasoning.observe: Template calls narrow only when end is not full pipeline; narrow returns 'already ends at' for last stage without touching marker; only restore caller is the boundary at the narrowed end.
reasoning.trace: narrow --until research then research aborted/compacted before its boundary; later 'build X' skips narrow.
reasoning.infer: Full-pipeline run silently truncated; nothing but that boundary undoes it.
reasoning.conclude: No undo path outside the boundary; fail-safe but surprising.

findings.summary: Bash(uv run:*) pre-approves every uv run command whenever Maker is active
findings.suggestion: Narrow the grant to the digest/narrow invocations (uv run --with <src> hm ...); keep printf/tail only if the compound needs them.

reasoning.observe: Frontmatter grants Bash(uv run:*), printf, tail; comment says only for the injected briefing.
reasoning.trace: uv run python -c ... runs unprompted while Maker is active; digest carries contributor-controlled commit subjects.
reasoning.infer: Injected text could steer an unprompted uv run; removes prompt before hm intent/memory_md writes.

findings.summary: restore_narrowed does a single byte-identity attempt; a lost race leaves the marker narrowed and later stages halt as 'unknown_stage'
findings.suggestion: Retry restore_narrowed once after re-reading; unknown_stage reason mentions a narrowing leftover.

reasoning.observe: Single _write_if_unchanged; touch rewrites the marker concurrently.
reasoning.trace: Bytes change between read and compare -> restore skipped, marker stays narrowed.
reasoning.infer: Next typed stage halts as unknown_stage, looks like a typo.

findings.summary: The restore-failure reason always says 'changed concurrently', although restore_narrowed returns False for several other causes
findings.suggestion: Return a reason from restore_narrowed and report the real cause.

reasoning.observe: restore_narrowed returns False for OSError, missing marker, nothing to restore, ValidationError, byte mismatch.

findings.summary: Active-intent id and metric_id are not clipped, so one long non-ASCII id can push the digest over the cap and make it 'unavailable'
findings.suggestion: Clip active rows' id and metric_id to _ID_MAX in _render before sizing.

reasoning.observe: _active_rows copies ids verbatim; _render clips items but not active; tests use ASCII ids.
reasoning.trace: After trimming tasks output still over cap -> unavailable.
reasoning.infer: AC-006 holds only for short ASCII ids.
reasoning.conclude: Cap guarantee has an unclipped input.

findings.summary: stage_description is built in several places and the atomic-command ctx entry looks unused
findings.suggestion: Delete stage_description from _atomic_command_files ctx if unread; share one helper with the codex stage-skill path.

reasoning.infer: Dead parameter plus second source of truth.

findings.summary: Comment says the description stays within a 120-char cap, but a long Maker name exceeds it
findings.suggestion: Reword to 'about 120 chars at the default name; a longer name lengthens it'.

reasoning.observe: Comment states an invariant; 40-char name gives ~150.
reasoning.trace: Reader takes the cap as enforced.

findings.summary: allowed-tools grants all `uv run`; the rendered rule is scoped to `hm`
findings.suggestion: allowed-tools: Bash(uv run --with {{ harness_maker_src_path }} hm *), Bash(printf:*), Bash(tail:*) — matching settings/Side.json.j2:11; never bare uv run:*.

reasoning.observe: SKILL.md.j2:21 grants Bash(uv run:*); settings templates already use Bash(uv run --with <src> hm *).
reasoning.trace: Any uv run (python -c, --with <pkg>) runs unprompted while Maker is active; digest carries contributor text.
reasoning.infer: Excess is arbitrary-code execution without a prompt; removes prompt before hm intent/memory_md.

findings.summary: restore_narrowed authorizes restore from a fresh snapshot, not the caller's, so it can erase a concurrent re-narrowing
findings.suggestion: Add expected_pipeline argument (caller's marker.pipeline from autopilot_caps.py:578); return False if the fresh marker.pipeline differs.

reasoning.observe: Boundary decides from caller's marker; restore_narrowed re-reads and writes restore_pipeline; compare protects only its own snapshot.
reasoning.trace: Concurrent narrow between caller load and restore read is overwritten.

findings.summary: Every restore_narrowed False is reported as 'changed concurrently', which misattributes the cause
findings.suggestion: Return a reason enum (no_marker, not_narrowed, validation, raced) and emit matching text.

reasoning.observe: restore_narrowed returns False for several causes; boundary maps all to the race text.
reasoning.trace: Foreign/stale/cleared marker reported as a race.

findings.summary: AC-007 never reads the 'Ends at' cell, so a row whose end stage is swapped can still pass
findings.suggestion: Split the matched row and compare the Ends-at cell to the golden expected end_stage; pin the unclear case to the exact research text.

reasoning.observe: Asserts cue membership over the whole row; no assertion isolates the end-stage cell.
reasoning.trace: Cue cell holds the words; Ends-at may say anything.

findings.summary: No test covers narrowing an already-narrowed marker; ADR-001 restore-source rule unpinned
findings.suggestion: Narrow twice (review then spec); assert restore_pipeline still original and boundary restore returns the original; pin the later-E case.

reasoning.trace: restore_pipeline = marker.pipeline unconditionally keeps all tests green.

findings.summary: AC-006 never exercises the worst-case cap interaction; render() can trim tasks below the SPEC floor of 3
findings.suggestion: Add an @example with 20 ~80-char intents, 8 rich tasks, long recent; assert >=3 tasks, >=3 intents, within cap, not unavailable.

reasoning.observe: Generator builds tasks without artifacts/session history; render comment concedes trimming below MIN_TASKS.

findings.summary: The edited integration test no longer shows the floor firing through the CLI; floor-on equals floor-off
findings.suggestion: Add a CLI case with fewer than k lexical hits; assert recurring-00 with floor on, absent with --no-count-floor, output <= 8192; rename contradicting tests.

reasoning.observe: Corpus has 20 lexical hits >= k so the floor is inert.
reasoning.trace: Dropping CLI plumbing keeps the test green.

findings.summary: AC-011 omits absent-case inputs (no --session-id, no .claude/); read-only check skipped as root
findings.suggestion: Add runs without --session-id and without .claude/; split the permission check with skipif-root.

reasoning.observe: Test always passes --session-id and pre-creates observability.
